story.iWant: React hooks that wrap the existing WebUSB, Firehose, Sahara, and Auth protocols
story.soThat: React components can use core flash logic without modifying it

tasks.task: Review core logic interfaces - Study public methods and types of WebUSBManager, FirehoseProtocol, SaharaProtocol, AuthStrategy
Create useWebUSB hook - Singleton ref, lazy init, connect/disconnect with store sync
Create useFirehose hook - Wrap configure, readPartitionTable, readPartition, writePartition
Create useSahara hook - Wrap handshake, uploadFirehose
Create useAuth hook - Wrap authenticate, loadCredentials
Create useTerminal hook - Convenience wrapper for terminal logging
Verify implementation - No changes to core/, auth/, services/

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: useWebUSB.ts exists and wraps WebUSBManager with connect(), disconnect(), getManager()
All hooks sync state with Zustand stores (deviceStore, partitionStore, flashStore, terminalStore)
All hooks log operations to terminalStore with info, success, error levels
ZERO changes to files in src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/
npm run dev runs without TypeScript errors

doc.snippet: WebUSB requires Chrome 89+, HTTPS. Session limits ~1.8GB per-session for Oppo devices. Large files require File System Access API.

artifact.reason: Primary class to wrap. Key methods: connect(), disconnect(), isConnected(), deviceInfo(), transferIn(), transferOut(), reset()
Main flash protocol. Key methods: configure(), getPartitions(), getAllPartitions(), readPartition(), writePartition(), writePartitionFromFile()
Bootloader protocol. Key methods: loadProgrammer(), execute(), currentState()
VIP authentication. AuthStrategy interface with execute(). OppoVipAuth implementation with sendDigest(), sendVerify(), sendSignature(), sendSha256Init()

artifact.symbol: TransferResult, DeviceInfo, PartitionInfo, VipAuthResult, FirehoseConfig, FirehoseResponse, SaharaState, SaharaResult
artifact.reason: Type definitions for protocols - reuse in hooks

node.usage: useRef, useCallback, useEffect for hook implementation
State management stores - NOT YET INSTALLED, required by Story 1.3
node.note: Zustand is required but not yet in package.json. Story 1.3 (ready-for-dev) will install it.

constraints.constraint: NEVER modify files in src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/ - these are preserved core logic
Use useRef to hold singleton protocol instances that persist across re-renders
Use useCallback for memoized methods to prevent re-creation on each render
Add useEffect cleanup to disconnect/cleanup resources on unmount
File naming: hooks use camelCase with 'use' prefix (useWebUSB.ts, useFirehose.ts)
Hooks depend on stores from Story 1.3 (ready-for-dev). If stores not available, use localStorage key 'qflash-settings' as fallback for settings.
